rules.preferred_position: Warehouse operator liability for loss or damage to stored goods is capped at the lesser of (a) actual replacement cost or (b) a fixed per-unit/per-pallet monetary cap agreed at contract execution; operator liable only upon proof of negligence or wilful misconduct; no liability for inherent vice, acts of God, or customer-packaging defects.
rules.fallback_position: Operator liable for loss or damage caused by its negligence up to actual replacement cost, subject to an aggregate per-incident cap equal to three months' storage fees; strict liability and consequential loss claims remain excluded.
rules.prohibited_language: Any language imposing strict liability, unlimited liability, or liability for indirect/consequential losses arising from loss or damage to stored goods.
rules.rationale: Warehousing agreements carry significant exposure for physical loss or damage to customer inventory; capping and fault-gating liability protects the company from outsized claims relative to storage revenue.

rules.preferred_position: Customer is solely responsible for insuring its own stored goods at full replacement value; company maintains only standard warehouse legal liability (WLL) coverage and is not required to carry all-risk cargo insurance; customer must name company as additional insured on its cargo policy and waive subrogation against company.
rules.fallback_position: Company maintains warehouse legal liability coverage at minimum industry-standard limits; customer retains obligation to insure goods above those limits and waives subrogation against company to the extent of any insurance recovery.
rules.prohibited_language: Any language requiring the company to carry all-risk or bailee's customer goods insurance, or any provision that deems the company an insurer of last resort for customer inventory.
rules.rationale: Allocating cargo insurance responsibility to the customer (the goods owner) prevents the company from bearing premium costs and claims exposure for inventory values it does not control.
